setting.codexNotifier.soundFile: Absolute path to a local WAV or MP3 file on this Windows computer, including for SSH/container projects. Use Customize notification sound to choose a file. Empty uses the system sound; unreadable or unsupported audio falls back to it. Applies to response, approval and question alerts. Restart VS Code once after upgrading an older notification broker.
command.codexNotifier.checkInstallation: Check / install components for this environment
command.codexNotifier.showEntry: Open session and mark this notification read
command.codexNotifier.configureApprovalH: Configure approval reminders for this environment
command.codexNotifier.removeApprovalHook: Remove approval reminders for this environment
command.codexNotifier.clearPrivateData: Clear notification data in this environment and on this computer
command.codexNotifier.clearLocalPrivateD: Clear all local notification caches only
configuration.title: Session Notifier
setting.codexNotifier.notificationsEnabl: Enable alerts. Turning this off still records notification history.
setting.codexNotifier.desktopNotificatio: Show Windows desktop notifications. Do Not Disturb may suppress them.
setting.codexNotifier.sound: Play notification sounds using the custom audio file or Windows system sound.
setting.codexNotifier.taskbarAttention: Show yellow/red taskbar attention and a status prefix in window preview titles. Adds a title variable on first use; read notifications clear the indicator.
setting.codexNotifier.blinkWindowTitle: Alternate the unread title dot every 0.8 seconds until read. Does not play sound, steal focus or flash the whole thumbnail background.
setting.codexNotifier.notifyOnDone: Notify when the current response ends.
setting.codexNotifier.notifyOnApproval: Notify when approval is required. Requires a configured and trusted approval hook.
setting.codexNotifier.notifyOnQuestion: Notify when a structured question tool call is detected.
setting.codexNotifier.onlyWhenUnfocused: Alert only while the window is in the background; foreground events still enter history.
setting.codexNotifier.autoReadOnWindowFo: Off by default: returning to a window preserves unread state, and a notification click reads only that item. When enabled, manually returning to a window reads all existing window reminders; switching conversation editor tabs reads that session. Notification navigation suspends bulk acknowledgement.
setting.codexNotifier.openLocation: Where notification clicks open the session. Sidebar mode focuses the target window before requesting the Codex session; a detected focus change preserves unread state.
setting.codexNotifier.localCodexHome: Codex home for local VS Code folders. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex. Only VS Code-origin sessions are collected.
setting.codexNotifier.localPythonPath: Local Python executable, without arguments. Empty uses py -3.
setting.codexNotifier.localSourceLabel: Source label for notifications from local VS Code windows.
setting.codexNotifier.localCollectorEnab: Collect VS Code Codex sessions in trusted local folders. SSH/container windows do not start local collection.
setting.codexNotifier.soundOnDone: Play sound when a response ends (on by default). Clicking and acknowledging are silent. Response completion does not mean the overall goal or a background job has finished.
setting.codexNotifier.desktopOnDone: Show a Windows desktop notification when a response ends. Off by default; color, unread state and sound remain available. Approval/question alerts follow the main desktop notification setting.
setting.codexNotifier.localCacheRetentio: Local collector notification-cache retention (1–30 days). Expiry runs while collection is active; original Codex conversations are untouched.
setting.codexNotifier.historyRetentionDa: Local shared notification-history and deduplication retention (1–30 days). Default: 7 days, at most 200 history entries. Legacy caches expire using file modification time.
setting.codexNotifier.language: Follow the VS Code display language by default, or choose Chinese or English. Menus, tasks, alerts and logs follow the selected language.
setting.codexNotifier.groupBy: Group by project directory and source, one task per turn; history keeps the unread/read notification list.
setting.codexNotifier.modelPrices: Override final USD prices per million tokens by exact model name; custom prices are not multiplied by service-tier factors.
setting.codexNotifier.pricingContext: Default estimates use official short-context prices; choose long for long-context rates. This selection applies to all built-in model prices.
setting.codexNotifier.pricingTier: auto uses the logged service tier, falling back to standard; override for your actual tier. API estimates are not subscription or provider bills.
